summary: Plans to add an elevator to each Dearborn building, with construction expected to start in 2027.
mechanism: add an elevator to each building

record.action: As CHA board chair, backed adding a second elevator to each Dearborn Homes building — the agency estimated the work at $40 million with construction expected to begin in 2027

Cancelled the CHA's request for proposals for new property managers covering thousands of units, citing federal HUD budget cuts and emerging needs at properties; the agency deferred the solicitation to early the following year
Committed additional security funding for Dearborn Homes in the CHA's 2026 budget after visiting the property and meeting property managers and residents
Worked with residents to select a replacement property manager the agency described as having a strong track record
